links.description: One row per interconnector in the NESO interconnector register (latest snapshot on or before the last-updated date): built links and pipeline projects with their registered capacity, connection and planned dates. Each built link has its own folder; projects not yet built are filed under Interconnects/Pipeline. Flow and limit statistics are in link_flows.

fields.name: profile_id
fields.description: Stable identifier: 'ic-' plus the slug of the project name (and stage where the register splits a link into stages).

fields.name: profile_rev
fields.description: Revision of this profile. It stays the same while the profile's content is unchanged and goes up by one when any value changes, so profile_id@profile_rev always means one fixed set of values.
fields.source: derived: previous build's revision and content_sha256

fields.name: content_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the profile's values (every field except profile_rev, content_sha256 and last_updated_utc, floats by their exact bits). Used to decide when profile_rev goes up.

fields.name: source_dataset
fields.description: Register snapshot the row was built from.

fields.name: source_key
fields.description: NESO interconnector register project number.

fields.name: last_updated_utc
fields.description: Profiles last updated: the date these profiles were brought up to.

fields.name: project_name
fields.description: Project name as registered.

fields.name: owner
fields.description: Registered customer (owner or developer).

fields.name: connection_site
fields.description: GB connection substation as registered.

fields.name: connection_kv
fields.description: Connection voltage, read from the connection site name (for example 'Grain 400kV Substation').

fields.name: stage
fields.description: Register stage, where a link is registered in stages.

fields.name: project_status
fields.description: Built, Under Construction/Commissioning, Awaiting Consents or Scoping.

fields.name: is_built
fields.description: True when project_status is Built.

fields.name: link_folder
fields.description: Profiles folder under Interconnects: one per built link, Pipeline for everything not yet built.

fields.name: register_import_mw
fields.description: Total import capacity as registered by NESO.

fields.name: register_export_mw
fields.description: Total export capacity as registered by NESO.

fields.name: effective_from_utc
fields.description: Date the registered capacity takes effect (pipeline projects: the planned connection date).

fields.name: elexon_fuel_code
fields.description: Elexon fuel type the link's flows are published under (for example INTNED for BritNed).

fields.name: named_operator
fields.description: [VERIFY] Operator or owner of the asset, from Interconnects/names.csv (named by hand, not published). Null where not named.

fields.name: named_site
fields.description: [VERIFY] Site name, from Interconnects/names.csv. Null where not named.

fields.name: named_address
fields.description: [VERIFY] Site address, from Interconnects/names.csv. Null where not named.

fields.name: named_by
fields.description: [VERIFY] Who named the asset and when, from Interconnects/names.csv.

fields.name: quality_flags
fields.description: Semicolon list of issues. Empty when none.

link_flows.description: Flow and NESO transfer-limit statistics for each built link over the 365 days to the last-updated date, one row per link (a link registered in stages has one row). Kept apart from links because they come from time-stamped operational data. profile_id is 'icflow-' plus the link folder slug.

fields.name: profile_id
fields.description: Stable identifier: 'ic-' plus the slug of the project name (and stage where the register splits a link into stages).

fields.name: profile_rev
fields.description: Revision of this profile. It stays the same while the profile's content is unchanged and goes up by one when any value changes, so profile_id@profile_rev always means one fixed set of values.
fields.source: derived: previous build's revision and content_sha256

fields.name: content_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the profile's values (every field except profile_rev, content_sha256 and last_updated_utc, floats by their exact bits). Used to decide when profile_rev goes up.

fields.name: source_dataset
fields.description: Datasets the statistics come from (Elexon FUELINST and, where usable, a NESO limit series).

fields.name: source_key
fields.description: Elexon fuel type the link's flows are published under.

fields.name: last_updated_utc
fields.description: Profiles last updated: the date these profiles were brought up to.

fields.name: link_folder
fields.description: Profiles folder under Interconnects (joins to links.link_folder).

fields.name: capacity_mw
fields.description: Larger of the link's registered import and export capacity (summed over register stages), the base for utilisation_p95.

fields.name: flow_window_start_utc
fields.description: Start of the flow statistics window (365 days to the last-updated date).

fields.name: flow_readings
fields.description: Five-minute flow readings in the window.

fields.name: flow_mw_min
fields.description: Lowest flow. Positive flow is into GB, negative is out of GB.

fields.name: flow_mw_p05
fields.description: 5th percentile of flow (into GB positive).

fields.name: flow_mw_p50
fields.description: Median flow (into GB positive).

fields.name: flow_mw_p95
fields.description: 95th percentile of flow (into GB positive).

fields.name: flow_mw_max
fields.description: Highest flow (into GB positive).

fields.name: flow_mw_mean
fields.description: Mean flow (into GB positive): the link's net position over the window.

fields.name: into_gb_share
fields.description: Fraction of readings with flow into GB.

fields.name: utilisation_p95
fields.description: 95th percentile of absolute flow over the larger registered capacity.

fields.name: limit_source
fields.description: NESO limit series used for the limit statistics. Null where none is usable (BritNed and Nemo Link publish limits whose dates cannot be read).

fields.name: limit_to_gb_mw_p05
fields.description: 5th percentile of NESO's transfer limit into GB (the restricted end).
fields.source: NESO interconnector limit series, Flow (MW) To GB

fields.name: limit_to_gb_mw_p50
fields.description: Median NESO transfer limit into GB.
fields.source: NESO interconnector limit series, Flow (MW) To GB

fields.name: limit_from_gb_mw_p05
fields.description: 5th percentile of NESO's transfer limit out of GB.
fields.source: NESO interconnector limit series, Flow (MW) From GB

fields.name: limit_from_gb_mw_p50
fields.description: Median NESO transfer limit out of GB.
fields.source: NESO interconnector limit series, Flow (MW) From GB

fields.name: limit_restricted_share
fields.description: Fraction of limit periods with a stated restriction in either direction.
fields.source: NESO interconnector limit series, reason columns

fields.name: flow_window_end_utc
fields.description: End of the window: the profiles last-updated date.

fields.name: named_operator
fields.description: [VERIFY] Operator or owner of the asset, from Interconnects/names.csv (named by hand, not published). Null where not named.

fields.name: named_site
fields.description: [VERIFY] Site name, from Interconnects/names.csv. Null where not named.

fields.name: named_address
fields.description: [VERIFY] Site address, from Interconnects/names.csv. Null where not named.

fields.name: named_by
fields.description: [VERIFY] Who named the asset and when, from Interconnects/names.csv.

fields.name: quality_flags
fields.description: Semicolon list of issues (for example flow_exceeds_capacity: an extreme published reading above 110% of registered capacity, kept as published). Empty when none.
